description.en_us: Compare every jar in the server's mods folder against Modrinth and CurseForge, and tell the admin which ones have a newer build. Fabric has no native way to notice an outdated mod; this does.
description.zh_cn: 把服务端 mods 目录里的每个 jar 与 Modrinth、CurseForge 上的版本逐一比对，告诉管理员哪些 Mod 有新版本。Fabric 服务端本身没有任何办法发现 Mod 过期，这个插件补上这一环。
